text: Missing-value policy slice implemented and verified: MissingValuePolicy now supports Reject, ZeroContribution, DropFromTerm, and finite ImputeConstant; EventModelBuilder validates before convolution; DesignAudit/EventModel carry per-event/per-column resolutions plus policy receipts; Reject returns typed MissingModulatorValue; DropFromTerm filters only the selected term; default zero behavior remains compatible. EventModelBuilderParitySuite passes 15/15 on JVM and 15/15 on Scala.js; full designJVM/test and designJS/test pass 167/167 each. Remaining P2.2 acceptance is intentionally open: centering scopes, ordered orthogonalization policy, richer empty/constant outcomes, row-permutation/run-cell invariance, and external parity fixtures still need work.
